caption: My leaks add up to more than what's left each month. How many subscriptions are you paying for and not using?

slides.title:
The R3 760 that leaks
out of my R19 600
p/m salary
Living in Boksburg
slides.body:
Male, 28
Single, no kids
Job: Dispatch clerk, courier depot
Net salary: R19 600 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: 1 bed in Boksburg North, water, refuse
slides.body: Rent is not a leak. I put it first so you can see how big the leaks look next to it.

slides.title: Delivery app fees
slides.includes: Delivery, service and tip fees only, not the food
slides.body: The food is a separate R1 900. These are the fees for someone to carry it 4 km.

slides.title: Subscriptions
slides.includes: Netflix, Showmax, DStv, Spotify, two apps I forgot I had
slides.body: I counted five. My statement counted seven.

slides.title: Gym
slides.body: I went twice last month. That's R345 a visit.

slides.title: Bank fees
slides.includes: Monthly fee, SMS notifications, cash withdrawal fees, one overdraft day
slides.body: A single day overdrawn cost me more than the notifications I never read.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Groceries R2 600, Petrol R1 900, Phone & data R650, Electricity R700, Funeral policy R220, Black tax R800, Stokvel R500
slides.body: Nothing in here surprised me. That's the problem with the boring stuff.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R19 600. The four leaks together come to R3 760, which is more than what's left.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statement to Beyond Horizon and the recurring charges showed up grouped together.

Seeing the gym and the two apps in one list was uncomfortable.

No bank login needed.
